title: Claude Fable and my Hydra-System
author: AlKillua
selftext:
Hi guys, 

my memecoin trading-bots are getting better. 

  
My newest Version is called "HYDRA".

HYDRA is an adaptive multi-strategy trading system that runs several strategies in parallel and automatically shifts capital toward whatever is working in the current market conditions. It continuously tunes itself based on live performance data instead of relying on fixed rules.

The parameters is the secret key, which i found with testing and testing and testing.

If you are interested, just dm me and i will explain you how it works.

comments.author: AlKillua
comments.body: Please just DM me if you have at least a little bit of experience in memecoins and trading

comments.author: hotcomputers
comments.body: Curious how you're handling overfitting if the parameters came mostly from testing. Live walk-forward results or a public paper trade log would make this way more convincing.
